title: Caption output v1
description: The JSON object a local vision-language model must return for one photo under prompt version caption-v1, and nothing else. This file is passed as-is to the Ollama `format` parameter, so it uses only type, properties, required, enum, items and additionalProperties. Length, sentence-count, uniqueness and style rules are checked by check_caption_output() in tools/validate_records.py at generation time, not by this schema.

ja_short.description: Short Japanese caption: one plain-form sentence ending with the Japanese full stop (U+3002), 15-60 characters, describing the main subject and its situation. No proper nouns, no people.

ja_detailed.description: Detailed Japanese caption: 3-5 plain-form sentences, each ending with the Japanese full stop (U+3002), 80-300 characters in total, covering composition, colors, and season, time of day and light only when visible cues exist, plus atmosphere. No proper nouns, no people.

en_short.description: Natural English rendering of ja_short with the same content and nothing added: one sentence ending with a period, 5-30 words, no proper nouns.

category.description: Category of the main subject of the photo.

flags.description: Things visible in the photo that keep it out of the dataset: person (a person or any body part), license_plate, logo_or_brand (a readable company, product or shop name, logo or mark). Empty array if none. Values must be unique (checked by check_caption_output() in tools/validate_records.py at generation time). A non-empty array permanently excludes the photo from the dataset, even if the detection looks like a false positive.
